# Whole-Person Treatment Planning Intensive

**Status:** `OWNER_APPROVED_DIRECTION / NOT_LAUNCHED`
**Authority:** `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_WHOLE_PERSON_BRAND.md` + `DEC-864`

This is the approved first educational product direction before Raimov Academy. It teaches evidence-aware whole-person case assessment and treatment planning within dental scope, including interdisciplinary coordination and referral boundaries.

No public programme, enrolment, date, price, faculty, certificate, outcome or accreditation claim exists yet. Activation requires approved learning outcomes and curriculum, faculty/reviewer ownership, evidence and case rights, medical/legal review, delivery capacity, terms and a separate release.
